people.name: Cornelius Henry Van zutphen
people.partner_quote: Neal is the founder of Intrinsic Wealth Counsel, Inc., majority owner, President, and Partner.
people.bio_note: Known publicly as 'Neal.' Founder and President; holds M.S., CFP, FBS (Certified Financial Behavior Specialist), and CRPC designations. Career in financial planning since 1983. Co-authored 'Financial Planner as Healer: Maximizing the Role of Financial Health Physician' with Bradley T. Klontz, Psy.D. and Kate Fries, published in the Journal of Financial Planning, Vol. 29, Issue 12 (December 2016), pages 52-59. His CFP Board Ambassador title appears on LinkedIn but was not independently corroborated beyond that in this pass. No source explicitly confirmed a family relationship to Casey Van Zutphen despite the shared surname — not assumed.
people.bio_source: Journal article verified via the Financial Planning Association's own journal archive (financialplanningassociation.org/article/journal/DEC16-financial-planner-healer-maximizing-role-financial-health-physician) and cross-confirmed on ResearchGate — both independent of the firm's own website, confirming the full citation and co-authors. CFP Board Ambassador title sourced only to LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/neal-van-zutphen), no separate roster/press confirmation found.

people.name: Cornelius H. Van zutphen
people.partner_quote: Casey is Partner, Chief Investment Officer, and the Portfolio Manager at Intrinsic Wealth Counsel, Inc.
people.bio_note: Known publicly as 'Casey.' Partner, Chief Investment Officer, and Portfolio Manager; CFA charterholder and CFP professional; operates the firm's second office in Tustin, CA and visits the Tempe, AZ office regularly; member of the Financial Planning Association of Orange County and the CFA Society of Orange County; graduated Magna Cum Laude from the University of Arizona (B.S., Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics) with two years of neurophysiology research; taught English in Japan and became fluent in Japanese. No source explicitly confirmed a familial relationship to Neal Van Zutphen despite the shared surname — not assumed or stated as fact.
people.bio_source: Corroborated via his LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/casey-van-zutphen-cfa-cfp), independent of the firm's own website, confirming CFA/CFP credentials, professional association memberships, and education/background details.

people.name: Daniela Urs Jones
people.partner_quote: Daniela is Partner, Vice President, and Financial Life Planner at Intrinsic Wealth Counsel, Inc.
people.bio_note: CFP and CFA charterholder; Partner at Intrinsic Wealth Counsel since 2018, focused on client life planning. Graduated Magna Cum Laude from Saint Mary's College (Notre Dame, IN) with a BBA in Finance, Marketing, and International Business. Prior to IWC, worked as a wealth manager at Barnes Investment Advisory, Inc., a Phoenix-based RIA, from May 2005 through January 2017 (~12 years). Member of CFA Society Phoenix and the Financial Planning Association of Greater Phoenix.
people.bio_source: Barnes Investment Advisory tenure (May 2005-January 2017) independently confirmed via her LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/daniela-jones-cfp-cfa), independent of the firm's own website — matches and specifies the previously general ~12-year figure.

people.name: Gieselle Lacey
people.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer & Senior Portfolio Administrator at Intrinsic Wealth Counsel (full name Gieselle Ebot Lacey, listed on the firm's own bio page as 'Gieselle Ebot'); joined the firm in May 2015 as an Administrative Assistant and was promoted into her current role. Originally from Cameroon; has lived in Arizona for 20+ years. Graduated Summa Cum Laude from the University of Arizona (B.S., Business Administration) and holds a master's in Finance from the University of Scranton; also pursuing the IACCP designation and holds a registered paraplanner certification.
people.bio_source: Checked 'Gieselle Ebot Lacey' / 'Gieselle Ebot' on LinkedIn and general web search — no independent LinkedIn profile, University of Scranton alumni mention, or professional directory listing found. The firm's own bio page (intrinsicwealthcounsel.com/about-us/gieselle-ebot/) remains the only substantive source; no independent coverage found beyond the firm's own website.
